youtube.description:
Mike Agugliaro joins me to talk about the one thing that holds most septic and excavation owners back: how they think. Mike started as an electrician, grew a New Jersey service company from under a million dollars to over $32 million with 165 trucks and 200 employees, exited it, and has since coached more than a thousand business owners. His company today is FuDog Group, where he helps people with life, business and wealth.

A lot of you tell me you can't find good help, you're working around the clock and getting nowhere, or you're comfortable at the same revenue you've had for years. We dig into why Mike says it's about mind growth, not mindset, how to take an honest look at yourself, and what it takes to get your family and your business pulling in the same direction.

What we cover:
- Why "I can't find good help" is a thinking problem, and how Mike hired someone the same day he changed his mind
- Why you won't build a $5 million company with a $500,000 identity
- The 24/7 story: where your hours really go
- Using AI without losing your critical thinking
- The mirror exercise, and how to try it tonight
- Getting your spouse and family on the same page
- What your hour is worth, and what to hand off
- Subtraction by addition: add one habit and the weaker one drops away
- Mike's advice to his younger self: keep moving forward

Find Mike at fudoggroup.com.
